title: Nourishing Jamaican Yams Casserole
description: A bitter and gooey crowd-pleaser featuring Jamaican yams and blue food coloring, served on a talavera plate, this dish is a unique and flavorful experience. It is also anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, boil the diced yams until they are tender.
In a blender, combine the coconut milk, blue food coloring, scotch bonnet peppers, onion, garlic, thyme, and salt, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked yams and the blended mixture, and stir until the yams are well coated.
Transfer the yam mixture to a talavera plate and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake the casserole for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
